trigger_condition: Encounter lasts exactly 15 minutes or measures exactly 2 meters
potential_consequence: Equivalent encounters produce inconsistent contact edges and fences

trigger_condition: Closed-space contact lacks duration or distance readings
potential_consequence: Brief or distant co-occupants may be fenced indiscriminately

trigger_condition: Proximity data is unavailable, stale, contradictory, or spoofed
potential_consequence: False or missed circles corrupt downstream fencing

trigger_condition: Contact edge is created or queried at the 14-day cutoff
potential_consequence: Boundary contacts are inconsistently retained or fenced

trigger_condition: Graph purge fails or runs more than one hour late
potential_consequence: Expired contact data remains available beyond policy

trigger_condition: Self-report arrives for Probable, Suspect, Confirmed, or deleted user

potential_consequence: Invalid transitions duplicate or weaken existing fences

trigger_condition: Positive result arrives for a user not currently Suspect
potential_consequence: Confirmed cases may not initiate required propagation

trigger_condition: Duplicate or concurrent status events target the same user
potential_consequence: Repeated cascades send duplicate alerts and corrupt statuses

trigger_condition: Recursive propagation encounters a graph cycle
potential_consequence: Cascade may loop indefinitely or exceed performance limits

trigger_condition: Graph membership changes while a promotion cascade runs
potential_consequence: Concurrent contacts may be skipped or inconsistently fenced

trigger_condition: New suspect path appears during downstream fence release
potential_consequence: Exposed contacts may be released despite active risk

trigger_condition: Medical override dissolves a fence with downstream contacts
potential_consequence: Dependent fences remain stale after an override

trigger_condition: Verified negative test predates a later exposure
potential_consequence: A later exposure is incorrectly cleared

trigger_condition: Referenced anonymous ID is missing, expired, or malformed
potential_consequence: Medical data may be lost or linked incorrectly

trigger_condition: Student ignores or abandons a scheduled-class prompt
potential_consequence: Attendance state remains ambiguous and circles incomplete

trigger_condition: Manual room selection is invalid, full, or no longer scheduled
potential_consequence: Student joins the wrong or nonexistent circle

trigger_condition: Student confirms the same class check-in multiple times
potential_consequence: Duplicate participants distort capacity and contact graphs

trigger_condition: Only one proximity participant confirms sporadic registration
potential_consequence: Unilateral confirmation may create unauthorized contact data

trigger_condition: One or both sporadic-registration prompts expire unanswered
potential_consequence: Pending circles may remain indefinitely or become accidental contacts

trigger_condition: Entry check encounters Probable, Suspect, Confirmed, or unknown status

trigger_condition: QR or NFC scan is unreadable, interrupted, duplicated, or offline
potential_consequence: Gate access becomes unsafe or unavailable

trigger_condition: Visitor abandons registration or account creation fails
potential_consequence: Visitor entry remains undefined or bypasses onboarding

trigger_condition: Biometric already belongs to another anonymous account
potential_consequence: One person may control multiple conflicting identities

trigger_condition: Deletion is requested during an active fence or investigation
potential_consequence: Deletion may break containment or violate retention obligations

trigger_condition: Deletion succeeds in only some linked data stores
potential_consequence: Residual records defeat complete deletion guarantees

trigger_condition: Hash collision or salt rotation changes an anonymous identifier
potential_consequence: Contacts may merge, split, or lose identity linkage

trigger_condition: User lacks an address or consent for one notification channel
potential_consequence: Required simultaneous delivery fails for otherwise reachable users

trigger_condition: Notification provider fails, times out, or returns ambiguous success
potential_consequence: Fenced users receive late, missing, or duplicate alerts

trigger_condition: LMS is unavailable or rejects Remote Attendance updates
potential_consequence: Fenced students remain marked for in-person attendance

trigger_condition: Fence dissolves after LMS Remote Attendance was applied
potential_consequence: Released students remain incorrectly remote

trigger_condition: Class circle has zero members
potential_consequence: Empty classes may be cancelled vacuously

trigger_condition: Fully fenced circle has no reservation or is already cancelled
potential_consequence: Cancellation errors may interrupt the fencing workflow

trigger_condition: A cancelled class later has members released from fences
potential_consequence: Class remains cancelled after its triggering condition disappears

trigger_condition: De-identification succeeds but audit-log persistence fails
potential_consequence: Sensitive identity access occurs without an audit record

trigger_condition: Dashboard aggregate contains a very small cohort
potential_consequence: Aggregates may reveal individual health status

trigger_condition: Questionnaire configuration is missing, empty, or invalid
potential_consequence: Entry decisions proceed without valid health screening

trigger_condition: Questionnaire configuration changes during an active response
potential_consequence: Answers are validated against mismatched questions

trigger_condition: User submits incomplete, invalid, or abandoned questionnaire answers
potential_consequence: Invalid screening data may permit entry

trigger_condition: Certificate is oversized, corrupted, encrypted, mislabeled, or malicious
potential_consequence: Uploads may exhaust storage or expose staff devices

trigger_condition: PersistentVolume is full, unavailable, or loses the upload
potential_consequence: Database links point to missing medical evidence

trigger_condition: Certificate validation is rejected, inconclusive, or later revoked

trigger_condition: Scanner and issuer clocks differ near QR expiration
potential_consequence: Valid users are denied or expired tokens accepted

trigger_condition: Signed QR token is copied and replayed before expiration
potential_consequence: Multiple people may enter using one valid token

trigger_condition: QR signature is invalid or signed by a retired key
potential_consequence: Forged access may be granted or valid access denied

trigger_condition: Role is modified or deleted while still assigned
potential_consequence: Users retain stale access or lose required permissions

trigger_condition: JWT permissions are revoked while an issued token remains valid
potential_consequence: Revoked users continue accessing protected operations

trigger_condition: Administrator removes the final role-management permission
potential_consequence: Administration becomes permanently locked out

trigger_condition: Hidden UI action is called directly without backend permission
potential_consequence: Unauthorized users bypass conditional UI rendering

trigger_condition: Graph or concurrent-user load exceeds specified capacity
